The department may issue an authorization for temporary residence upon determining that:

1. The basement or cellar referenced in such application is an eligible basement or cellar residence;

2. Such eligible basement or cellar residence contains an apartment that was in existence prior to April 20, 2024; and

3. Such eligible basement or cellar residence has been inspected, and:
